_comment: The commands docs.kubenest.io shows that the released CLI does not have.
Read by scripts/check_unsupported_callouts.py. Every occurrence of a command
listed here, anywhere under the scanned content directory, must sit inside a
<Callout> whose first sentence is exactly 'Not supported by the current
release.' and which names the release that removes it. That sentence is the
machine-readable marker: it is the dated exception in README.md section 'The
docs are the specification', and it is the string G0.7's CLI metadata will
skip on when it compares the command tree to the pages.
PLAN section 6.6 found FOUR by grepping four strings: kubenest health,
kubenest node reboot, cluster set-reboot-window, and backup restore. The
third is absent here on purpose, and not because it was fixed: there was
never such a command. pkg/cmd/cluster.go registers set-window, which is
implemented, so os-patching.mdx shows that command and no occurrence of
set-reboot-window is left to call out. The self-test fails when a listed
page no longer shows the command, so listing a removed one would fail there.
The app-layer pages (deploying, addons, console, index) carry the same
callout for commands that were REMOVED under decision D1 rather than
stubbed. They are deliberately not listed: those pages need one page-level
callout over a frozen family of commands, not a callout around every
occurrence of every verb, and a list entry here means the latter.

unsupported.because: PLAN section 6.4 records it MISSING from the command tree; it is a T2.x day-2 verb.
pkg/cmd/root.go registers login, logout, platform, cluster and backup only. There is no node verb.
Registered as a skeleton (pkg/cmd/backup.go newBackupSkeletonCommand): it exits non-zero with 'not yet implemented'.
